name: std-agent-memory
description: std-agent-memory — what an in-app assistant remembers across conversations. Owns AgentMemory rows (content + its embedding, ownerId = the real @user). RECALL { messages } embeds the last turn with `call-service llm embed`, ranks the stored memories whose embedding is comparable (same length as the query's) by cosine similarity and emits RECALLED { messages, context } with the closest `recallLimit` memories joined into one context string (empty when nothing is stored); if embedding fails it emits RECALLED with an empty context, so a memory outage never blocks the assistant. REMEMBER { reply } stores the exchange it just recalled for (asked + answered) with its embedding. AgentMemoryRecall is headless (failures show as toasts); AgentMemoryBrowse is the list view. Rows are meant to be private to their owner: the binding organism declares the @read scoping.
